messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++17 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, w, x, y, z;
double alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon, zeta;
long long arr[100045], brr[100045];
string str;
map<long long, long long> mp;

int main() {
    scanf("%lld %lld %lld", &a, &b, &c);
    if (b <= c) {
        long long g = std::__gcd(a, b);
        printf("%lld/%lld", a / g, b / g);
        return 0;
    }
    long long max_diff_index = -1;
    for (long long idx = 1; idx <= c; ++idx) {
        long long j = idx * a / b;
        if (abs(idx * a - j * b) > abs(idx * a - (j + 1) * b))
            j++;
        if (max_diff_index == -1 || abs(s * a - max_diff_index * b) * idx > abs(idx * a - j * b) * s) {
            max_diff_index = j;
            s = idx;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld/%lld", max_diff_index, s);
}
</perturbed_code_1>
